phone.alone.welcome.title: Nocturne remembers your day
phone.alone.welcome.lead: Keep notes, photos and voice notes, write your journal, and see your calendar beside your days.
phone.alone.start.title: Your memory lives on this phone
phone.alone.start.works.keep: Keep notes, photos and voice notes
phone.alone.start.works.journal: Write your journal and check in
phone.alone.start.works.calendar: See your calendar and health beside your days
phone.alone.start.works.find: Find anything you kept by its words
phone.alone.start.waitsHint: A mind can come from Nocturne on your own computer. Your memory then moves there.
phone.alone.start.lostPhone: If this phone is lost, what you kept goes with it. Save a backup now and then in {thisPhone}.
phone.alone.offer.lead: Nocturne can show what’s in this phone’s calendar and health readings beside your days. Both are optional. You can change your mind any time in {thisPhone}.
phone.alone.calendar.why.title: Show your calendar in Nocturne?
phone.alone.calendar.why.where: It stays on this phone, in Nocturne’s memory, and goes wherever your memory goes: into a locked copy or to a mind, only if you turn those on.
phone.alone.calendar.why.for: Today shows what’s on, and your journal shows each appointment at its time. Each line shows which calendar it came from.
phone.alone.today.status: Your memory is on this phone
phone.alone.today.empty: Nothing kept yet today. Tap {keep} to keep something.
phone.alone.noMind.title: Your page needs a mind to write it.
phone.alone.noMind.body: A mind reads what you keep, writes this page each morning and answers your questions.
phone.alone.reminder.body: No backup yet. If this phone is lost, what you kept goes with it.
phone.alone.find.above: Found by their words. Answers need a mind.
phone.alone.find.none: Nothing you kept has those words.
phone.alone.find.before: Find anything you kept by its words.
phone.alone.find.empty: Nothing kept yet. What you keep can be found here by its words.
phone.alone.thisPhone.can: Your memory is on this phone. It can keep, find, forget and delete, and save a backup to a file.
phone.alone.thisPhone.removing: Removing the app removes your memory from this phone. Save a backup first.
phone.alone.delete.title: Delete everything on this phone?
phone.alone.delete.body: Everything you kept, your journal, check-ins, calendar and health readings in Nocturne go from this phone for good. Your calendar and Health themselves aren’t touched. A backup you saved elsewhere isn’t touched.
phone.alone.mind.title: Give Nocturne a mind
phone.alone.mind.lead: A mind reads what you keep, writes your page each morning and answers your questions. It can run on a computer of your own.
phone.alone.mind.step2: Choose {addAPhone} there, and scan its code from this phone.
phone.alone.mind.step3: Your memory moves to the computer, and this phone works with it.
phone.alone.backup.title: Save a backup
phone.alone.backup.lead: One file with everything you kept, locked with a passphrase you choose. Keep it somewhere other than this phone.
phone.alone.backup.next: Next, choose where to save it.
phone.alone.restore.title: Bring back your memory
phone.alone.restore.lead: Choose your backup file and type its passphrase.
phone.alone.restore.done.title: Your memory is back on this phone.
phone.alone.restore.done.body: {count} things, every page and your journal.
phone.alone.damaged.title: Nocturne couldn’t open your memory on this phone.
phone.alone.damaged.body: Nothing was deleted. Bring back a backup, or ask for help.
phone.alone.full: This phone is nearly full. Free some room so Nocturne can keep more.
